inputs.text: [excited] It was 5.5 feet long — like a tall Dad lying on the ground! Standing up, it was about 3 feet tall — [amazed] as tall as a 4-year-old! And it weighed 70 kilos — [proud] as heavy as a kangaroo!
[confident] Stockier, mostly. [proud] A bigger head, stronger teeth than a gray wolf.
